task_title: Arcane level-5 milestone grants a weapon-gated active ability

plan_review.notes: Two plan reviews ran: gpt-5.4 (v1, rejected, 6 concerns) then claude-opus-4.8 adversarial (v2, approved_with_changes, 10 concerns incl. 3 alternatives argued). Alt A (equip-gate the active on weapon swap instead of fire-gating) rejected: per-frame equip/unequip would fight the player-configured ability bar, churn cooldown state on every swap, and complicate slot-cap re-equip; adopted the reviewer fallback instead (HUD surfaces the unmet prerequisite on the slot). Alt B (reuse an existing catalog active) rejected: no existing active carries arcane class identity; new IDs also avoid the persisted-kind mismatch that killed v1. Alt C (unconditional active) rejected: breaks the ADR weapon-class contract on post-unlock weapon swap. Adopted: new ability IDs instead of repurposing (v1-1); weaponPrerequisite on actives incl. the .strict() zod schema (v1-2, v2-3); do NOT gate forceActivateAbility (v2-1); HUD slot shows unmet-prereq state and the bar unhides for non-spell actives (v2-2); AI loadout evaluator zeroes weapon-gated actives on mismatched weapons (v2-4); expect an intended headless fingerprint delta and diff-review it (v2-5); unlock VFX flash for active grants (v2-6); widen the revokeRequests TYPE and derive revoke kind (v2-7); cite the ADR by dated filename due to the 0061 number collision (v2-8); skill lab + achievements decision documented (v1-3); slot-cap/carryover tests (v1-6). Rejected with reason: cutting the L15 evolved tier (v2-10) — applyMilestone revokes the L5 grant at L15, so a passive L15 would delete the player active.

rounds.notes: Automated code_review tool invoked during recovery after the grant-kind fallback, HUD/banner, evaluator, apple metrics, balance evidence, slot-cap, and lab-owned-active fixes. It returned no review comments; the local autofind binary was unavailable, so this was supplemented by the multi-model diff review below.

Three independent code-review agents reviewed the recovery diff. claude-sonnet-4.6 reported no significant issues and explicitly validated the abilityGrantKind fallback and test weapon IDs; gpt-5.3-codex reported clean; gemini-3.1-pro-preview reported clean. A follow-up independent grade found two test/lab precision gaps (slot-cap active ownership and skill-lab owned-active display), both fixed before final grading.
